title: 退款政策
content: Refund requests are reviewed according to order status and payment records. A review does not move money automatically. The customer should provide the order ID and reason.

title: 退款到账时间
content: After a refund is approved by a human agent, the payment provider usually needs three to seven business days for the refund to arrive and post the money. The exact time depends on the payment method.

title: 配送状态说明
content: On the way means the order has been handed to a courier. Delivered means the delivery system recorded completion. If the status is stale, support can review the order history.

title: 配送延迟处理
content: For a late delivery, confirm the order ID and current delivery status first. Compensation is only a proposal until a human agent verifies the case.

title: 优惠券使用说明
content: 优惠券是否可用取决于有效期、适用门店、最低消费和订单商品。系统只能查询资格，不能绕过规则强制使用。

title: 账户访问问题
content: For account access problems, do not ask the customer to disclose a password or full payment card number. Create a support request and use a verified contact channel.

title: 人工审核边界
content: Refunds, compensation, account changes and other side effects require human or policy approval. The assistant can explain status and prepare a review request, but cannot execute money movement.

title: Política de reembolso
content: Las solicitudes de reembolso se revisan según el estado del pedido y los registros de pago. La revisión no mueve dinero automáticamente y requiere el número de pedido.

title: Status da entrega
content: Em trânsito significa que o pedido foi entregue ao entregador. Entregue significa que o sistema registrou a conclusão. Se o status estiver desatualizado, o suporte pode revisar o histórico.
